Blaze.description: Starter deck. Torchic grows into Blaziken, with Camerupt and Arcanine backing it up. Simple and hard-hitting.

Torrent.description: Starter deck. Mudkip grows into Swampert, which heals itself with Water Energy. Wailord is a big wall and Pelipper helps out.

Overgrow.description: Starter deck. Treecko grows into Sceptile, which moves Grass Energy around. Nuzleaf and the fast Ninjask keep up the pressure.

Ruby.description: EX Ruby & Sapphire theme deck: Blaziken, Hariyama and Delcatty (Fire and Fighting).

Sapphire.description: EX Ruby & Sapphire theme deck: Swampert, Grovyle and Weezing (Water and Grass).

Oasis.description: EX Sandstorm theme deck: Armaldo, Sandslash and Azumarill (Fighting and Water), with Claw Fossil.

Caravan.description: EX Sandstorm theme deck: Cradily, Arcanine and Nuzleaf (Grass and Fire), with Root Fossil.

WindBlast.description: EX Dragon theme deck: Flygon, Ninjask and Magneton (Grass and Lightning).

FireFang.description: EX Dragon theme deck: Salamence, Camerupt and Crawdaunt (Fire and Water).

Team Magma.description: EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua theme deck: Team Magma's Groudon, Aggron, Claydol and Houndoom.

Team Aqua.description: EX Team Magma vs Team Aqua theme deck: Team Aqua's Kyogre, Walrein, Lanturn and Mightyena.

Wish Maker.description: EX Hidden Legends theme deck: Jirachi, Metagross, Starmie and Tentacruel (Psychic and Water).

Forest Guardian.description: EX Hidden Legends theme deck: Dark Celebi, Bellossom, Dodrio and Loudred (Grass and Colorless).

Magma Spirit (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Champion, 15-and-over division: Tsuguyoshi Yamato (Japan), undefeated. Team Magma's Groudon and Zangoose with Magma Energy.

Blaziken Tech (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Championship runner-up, 15-and-over division: Chris Fulop (USA). Blaziken and Blaziken ex with Delcatty, Rayquaza ex and Rare Candy.

Team Rushdown (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Championship runner-up, 11-14 division: Kevin Nguyen (USA). Gardevoir and Gardevoir ex with Boost Energy and Magneton.

Rocky Beach (Worlds 2004).description: 2004 World Championship runner-up, 10-and-under division: Reed Weichler (USA). Swampert, Swampert ex and Suicune ex.

Echo.description: Expedition theme deck: Alakazam copies the opponent's attacks, backed by Haunter, Clefable and Chansey (Psychic and Colorless).

Electric Garden.description: Expedition theme deck: Vileplume, Weezing, Raichu and Flaaffy (Grass and Lightning).

Rock Garden.description: Aquapolis theme deck: Nidoking, Exeggutor, Marowak and Blissey (Grass and Fighting).

Abyss.description: Aquapolis theme deck: Kingdra, Ninetales, Porygon2 and Miltank (Fire and Water).

Eeveelution.description: Skyridge theme deck: Eevee evolves into Vaporeon, Flareon or Jolteon, backed by Electrode, Lapras and Ursaring (Fire, Water and Lightning).

Mind Machine.description: Skyridge theme deck: Xatu takes any Technical Machine, with the three Miracle Spheres, Ditto, Snorlax and Raticate (Psychic and every basic Energy).

Jessie.description: Team Rocket Returns theme deck: Dark Tyranitar and Dark Marowak hit hard, with Dark Arbok and Rocket's Wobbuffet in support (Fighting, Grass and Psychic).

Starcharge.description: Deoxys theme deck: fast Psychic and Grass attackers led by Deoxys, with Shiftry, Shedinja and Meteor Falls.

Jetstream.description: Deoxys theme deck: Fire, Lightning and Water Pokémon soften up the opponent before Rayquaza swoops in.

Hydrobloom.description: Emerald theme deck: Water and Grass Pokémon wear the opponent down while Feebas evolves into Milotic.

Wildfire.description: Emerald theme deck: Fire and Lightning Pokémon blaze through the opponent's defenses, with two Manectric and Blaziken.

FireRed.description: FireRed & LeafGreen theme deck: Charmander grows into Charmeleon, with Arcanine and Pidgeot (Fire, Water and Colorless).

LeafGreen.description: FireRed & LeafGreen theme deck: Ivysaur, Beedrill and Magneton outwit the opponent (Grass, Lightning and Colorless).

James.description: Team Rocket Returns theme deck: Dark Dragonair finds Dark Dragonite with Evolutionary Light, with Dark Weezing and Dark Magneton (Water, Lightning and Grass).

Golden Sky.description: Unseen Forces theme deck: Ho-Oh, Typhlosion and Magcargo burn through with Fire and Fighting Energy.

Silvery Ocean.description: Unseen Forces theme deck: Lugia and Meganium lead Grass and Psychic Pokémon, with Fluffy Berry and Protective Orb.

Breakthrough.description: Delta Species theme deck: Crobat δ, Dragonair δ and Holon's Electrode with Grass, Lightning and Metal Energy.

Steeplechase.description: Delta Species theme deck: Shelgon δ, Umbreon δ and Rapidash race ahead with Fire and Metal Energy.

Groundbreaker.description: Legend Maker theme deck: Golem and fossil Pokémon dig in with Grass, Fighting and React Energy.

Shadowquake.description: Legend Maker theme deck: Gengar haunts the field alongside Water Pokémon, with React Energy and Power Tree.

FireMist.description: Holon Phantoms theme deck: Latias δ and Blaziken with Mankey δ and Exeggcute δ, on Fire and Fighting Energy.

FloodRush.description: Holon Phantoms theme deck: Latios δ, Bellossom δ and fossil Omanyte δ on Water and Psychic Energy.

Green Cyclone.description: Crystal Guardians theme deck: Venusaur's Chlorophyll powers Grass Pokémon like Grovyle and Loudred.

Storm Surge.description: Crystal Guardians theme deck: Blastoise with Charmeleon δ, Fearow δ and Pelipper δ on Water and Lightning Energy.

Earth Shower.description: Crystal Guardians theme deck: Swampert, Dugtrio and Medicham shake the ground with Water and Fighting Energy.

Power Wave.description: Dragon Frontiers theme deck: Feraligatr δ's Battle Aura and Cloyster δ guard a δ team on Lightning and Fighting Energy.

Shadow Blaze.description: Dragon Frontiers theme deck: Typhlosion δ, Arbok δ and Lickitung δ with Fire and Psychic Energy.

Mind Game.description: Power Keepers theme deck: Gardevoir, Dusclops and Sableye play with Phoebe's Stadium on Psychic and Water Energy.

Dark Blast.description: Power Keepers theme deck: Mightyena and Sidney's Stadium lead a Fire and Darkness team.

Psychic Mimic.description: Alakazam bends spoons and minds alike. Mr. Mime builds invisible walls around the show.

Haunted Mansion.description: The doors creak open by themselves. Gengar and the ghosts of the old manor want to play.

Embrace.description: Gardevoir's gentle embrace hides a terrible power. Kirlia and Xatu read the future in her light.

Cosmic Duo.description: When sun and moon align, strange stones begin to glow. Even Mew drifts down to watch.

Thunderbolt.description: A cheeky spark becomes a raging storm. Raichu and friends charge the air until it crackles.

Lighthouse.description: Ampharos shines over the stormy sea. Plusle and Minun cheer every ship back to shore.

Magnetic Field.description: Compasses spin wildly near the power plant. Magneton hums and Electrode is ready to blow.

Evolution Prism.description: One small Eevee, a thousand possible futures. Which stone will it touch today?

Charizard Blaze.description: A wildfire roars across the field. Charizard leads the blaze while Moltres fans the flames.

Firestarter.description: The flame of a young Torchic grows into Blaziken's fiery kick. Camerupt rumbles below.

Volcano.description: Deep in the volcano the old fires wake. Typhlosion and Entei rise from the molten rock.

Will-o'-the-Wisp.description: Ghostly lights dance in the night forest. Follow them and Ninetales will be waiting.

Egg Bomb.description: A bundle of strange eggs, warm from the sun. Nobody knows what hatches when they explode.

Cotton Breeze.description: Fluffy seeds ride the summer wind. Where they land, spores and sleepy powder follow.

Leaf Storm.description: The forest guardian waves its great leaf fans. Every tree in the woods joins the storm.

Silver Wind.description: Wings of dust shimmer in the moonlight. The meadow swarm takes flight together.

Toxic Cloud.description: A purple haze settles over the swamp. Crobat flits through it while Muk bubbles below.

Jungle Strike.description: Leaves rustle and a blade flashes through the canopy. Sceptile never misses its mark.

Flower Garden.description: The prettiest garden in Hoenn hides a poisonous secret. Smell the flowers at your own risk.

Overgrowth.description: Ancient vines wake across the old ruins. Venusaur and Meganium tend the wild garden.

Bug Collection.description: A young collector's prize jar, buzzing with life. Shedinja watches from its empty shell.

Poison Kingdom.description: A king and queen rule the thorny wastes. Their desert court is armed with stingers.

Hoenn Fossils.description: Mr. Stone's lab brings ancient life back from stone. The old seas are full again.

Kanto Fossils.description: From the depths of Mt. Moon, shells and claws stir. Aerodactyl screeches across the sky.

Chaos Flash.description: Golduck's eyes glow in the stream. Crabs and fish gather around the strange light.

Deep Dive.description: Far below the waves sings the great Wailord. Its song calls the whole sea to battle.

Sea Dragon.description: A whirlpool forms where the sea dragon sleeps. Kingdra rises when the tide turns.

Rain Dance.description: When Ludicolo dances, the rain begins. Milotic glides through the puddles like a rainbow.

Permafrost.description: A blizzard howls from the frozen cave. Regice wakes and the whole field turns to ice.

Seafoam Islands.description: Icy caves rise from the foaming sea. Lapras ferries travelers past Dewgong and Cloyster.

Major Tsunami.description: The river bursts its banks with a roar. Feraligatr rides the wave all the way to shore.

Hydro Cannon.description: Blastoise braces its shell and aims its cannons. Poliwrath swims in from the falls.

Raging Sea.description: A calm sea turns violent in an instant. Gyarados rises and the sharks smell blood.

Legendary Waters.description: The ocean's ancient master stirs. Kyogre surfaces and Suicune purifies its path.

Mud Wave.description: Swampert rides the muddy tide from the marsh. Lanturn lights the way in the murky water.

Dragon Dance.description: Dragons of every color gather on the sky pillar. Their roars shake the clouds.

Eon Twins.description: Two dragons that can turn invisible soar over Southern Isle. Legends follow in their wake.

Lazy Day.description: Slaking naps all day and wakes up stronger than anyone. Its friends just let it sleep.

Sandstorm.description: Desert winds hide the dragon of the dunes. Flygon's wings sing in the sandstorm.

Sky High.description: Feathers fill the sky above the route. The fastest birds race to strike first.

Lucky Eggs.description: The nurses of the Pokémon Center have a kind heart and a strong right hook.

Moonlight.description: On full moon nights, the fairies of Mt. Moon sing and dance. Their lullabies are irresistible.

City Pests.description: Back alleys are full of scrappy critters. Whatever you dropped, Linoone already found it.

Hyper Voice.description: Exploud turns up the volume. The quiet ones in the band are full of surprises.

Overzealous.description: Four arms, one goal. Machamp and the fighters of the dojo never back down.

Martial Arts Dojo.description: The masters of punch, kick and spin meet in the ring. Medicham meditates by the door.

Rock Slide.description: Boulders roll down the mountain pass. Golem leads the avalanche straight at you.

Earthquake.description: The ground cracks open as Groudon awakens. Donphan and Dugtrio make it tremble.

Iron Wall.description: Aggron guards its mountain with a body of steel. Skarmory and Scizor patrol the peaks.

Meteor Mash.description: A comet's iron heart beats inside Metagross. Jirachi grants one wish before it sleeps.

Dark Aura.description: Mountains crumble where Tyranitar walks. Its larva dig through rock to follow.

Night Howl.description: Mightyena howl when the moon rises. Absol appears whenever disaster is near.

Magma Strike.description: Team Magma marches to expand the land. Their Groudon is the heart of the plan.

Magma Eruption.description: Magma's volcano base rumbles with smoke and fire. Camerupt is ready to erupt.

Aqua Assault.description: Team Aqua sets sail to expand the seas. Their Kyogre leads the raid from the deep.

Aqua Ambush.description: Team Aqua's sneakiest agents hide in the shallows. A flash of lightning springs the trap.

Poltergeist.description: Lights flicker and the cards start to move on their own. Gengar ex has come out to play.

Psychic Link.description: Kirlia and Gardevoir share a single mind. Xatu sees what they plan before it happens.

Moon and Sun.description: Lunatone and Solrock circle each other like the sky itself. Mewtwo ex watches from afar.

Space Virus.description: A meteor fell and something crawled out. Deoxys changes its shape to fit any battle.

Big Eggsplosion.description: Exeggutor's heads all think something different. Slowbro doesn't think at all.

Eevee Party.description: Every Eeveelution is invited and nobody wants to miss the fun. Ditto came in disguise.

Mega Thunder.description: Storm clouds gather over the power plant. Raichu ex and Zapdos ex ride the lightning.

Conductivity.description: Ampharos ex shines brighter with every spark. The lighthouse calls Raikou ex home.

Energy Bomb.description: The old power plant hums with danger. One wrong step and Electrode ex goes boom.

Burn Down.description: Charizard ex spreads its wings and the sky turns orange. Nothing is left standing.

Blaze Kick.description: Blaziken's legs burst into flame. Camerupt ex and Torkoal fuel the fire.

Fire Spin.description: The legendary dog of the volcano runs free. Typhlosion ex and Arcanine follow its trail.

Nine Tails.description: A thousand-year-old fox with nine burning tails. Curse it and you'll regret it forever.

Energy Trans.description: Venusaur ex soaks up the sun from its giant flower. The whole jungle blooms around it.

Spore Cloud.description: The meadow fills with drifting cotton and dust. Anyone who breathes it falls asleep.

Fan Away.description: Shiftry's leaf fans whip up a hurricane. Everything in the forest is swept away.

Wing Dust.description: Beautifly and Dustox scatter their dust under the moon. The meadow sparkles and stings.

Venom Wing.description: Crobat ex swoops out of the cave. Its poisonous friends are never far behind.

Forest Blade.description: The forest is Sceptile's kingdom. Its leaf blades flash faster than the eye can follow.

Block Dust.description: Vileplume ex shakes its petals and the air fills with stinging pollen.

Wonder Guard.description: Nincada sheds its shell and something new moves inside. Shedinja feels no pain.

Royal Poison.description: Nidoking and Nidoqueen rule with horns and venom. Cacturne ex guards the desert gate.

Ancient Claws.description: Living fossils climb out of the past. Armaldo ex and Cradily ex rule the old reefs.

Primal Lock.description: Aerodactyl ex's ancient roar freezes modern Pokémon in fear. The fossil age returns.

Crab Hammer.description: The beach belongs to the crabs. Kingler and Crawdaunt pinch anyone who comes near.

Whale Song.description: Wailord ex is the biggest Pokémon of all. Its song echoes across the whole ocean.

Dragon Whirlpool.description: Kingdra stirs up whirlpools from the ocean floor. Octillery ink clouds the water.

Reflect Energy.description: Milotic ex reflects the light like a living rainbow. The rain dancers follow its lead.

Ice Age.description: The glaciers return. Regice ex and Articuno ex bring an endless winter.

Kanto Shores.description: Starfish, seals and shells wash up on Kanto's beaches. The tide brings them all to battle.

Hydro Pump.description: Blastoise ex opens fire and the whole field is flooded. Poliwrath swims through it all.

Red Tide.description: A red Gyarados was seen in the lake. The sharks are restless too.

Tidal Legends.description: Kyogre's rains flood the land and Suicune sweeps across the waves. The legends are awake.

Muddy Water.description: Swampert churns the marsh into a muddy flood. Quagsire and Whiscash dig in.

Dragon Wave.description: Dragonite ex soars above the clouds with Rayquaza ex. Altaria sings to the storm.

Dragon Lift.description: Salamence ex finally has wings. Rayquaza descends from the sky to fly beside it.

Eon Flight.description: Latios and Latias streak across the sky faster than jets. The twins never fly alone.

Slack Off.description: Slaking is the laziest champion in Hoenn. When it finally gets up, everyone runs.

Sand Guard.description: A singing wind blows across the desert. Flygon guards the oasis from its sandstorm.

Drive Off.description: The birds of the route chase away anyone who enters their sky. Dodrio runs, Swellow dives.

Egg Surprise.description: Every Chansey carries a special egg. You never know what kindness it will bring.

Sleepy Song.description: Wigglytuff ex sings the sweetest lullaby. Clefable ex waves a finger and magic happens.

Pickup Crew.description: A scrappy gang of city critters that never leave home empty-handed.

Uproar.description: Exploud's band is louder than a thunderstorm. Ditto and Kecleon do the backup voices.

Cross Chop.description: Machamp throws a thousand punches a minute. Hariyama ex catches what it misses.

Pure Power.description: Medicham ex meditates on the mountaintop until its power overflows.

Rock Tumble.description: Golem ex curls up and rolls down the mountain. Rhydon smashes what's left.

Magnitude.description: Groudon ex raises the land from the sea. The whole field shakes with every step.

Steel Fortress.description: Aggron ex and Registeel ex stand like a wall of iron. Skarmory circles the fortress.

Comet Punch.description: Beldum fell from the stars and became Metagross ex. Its fists hit like meteors.

Sand Damage.description: Tyranitar ex wakes in a storm of sand. Even the shadows of Team Rocket follow it.

Bad News.description: When Absol appears, disaster follows. Mightyena's pack hunts in the dark.

Rocket's Poison Gas.description: Team Rocket's lab leaks something nasty. Dark Crobat and Dark Weezing lead the gas attack.

Rocket's Power Plant.description: Team Rocket hijacked the power plant. Dark Ampharos lights their secret base.

Rocket's Tidal Wave.description: Team Rocket stole the legends of the sea. Dark Gyarados guards their submarine.

Rocket's Furnace.description: Team Rocket's secret forge burns with stolen fire. Dark Houndoom guards the gate.

Rocket's Quarry.description: Deep in the mine, Team Rocket digs for treasure. Dark Steelix bores through the rock.

Rocket's Dragons.description: Team Rocket's darkest experiment woke Dark Dragonite. Dark Hypno keeps it under control.

Rocket's Elite.description: The boss's prized collection of stolen Pokémon. Rocket's Mewtwo ex leads the elite.

Magma Hideout.description: Deep inside the volcano, Team Magma plots to raise the land. Groudon waits for the signal.

Overheat.description: Magma's furnaces run hotter every day. Camerupt and Houndoom guard the lava pits.

Aqua Hideout.description: Team Aqua's secret cave opens to the sea. Kyogre waits below the dock.

Power Shift.description: Team Aqua's lightning squad charges up in the dark. Raikou ex and Zapdos ex joined for the pay.

Shadow Curse.description: Something moves behind you in the mirror. Gengar and Banette ex love a good scare.

Heal Dance.description: Gardevoir dances in the moonlight and every wound closes. Xatu keeps watch.

Eclipse.description: When the moon covers the sun, Grumpig and Hypno lull the world to sleep.

Forme Change.description: Deoxys shifts between attack, defense and speed like a living cipher from space.

Psychic Exchange.description: Exeggutor trades thoughts with its heads. Slowking wears a crown of pure wisdom.

Genetic Code.description: Mew sleeps inside every Pokémon's genes. Celebi ex and the Unown keep the secret of life.

Prism Burst.description: Five Eeveelutions shine in five colors. Ho-Oh ex and Lugia ex answer the rainbow's call.

Pika Bolt.description: Pikachu's cheeks spark with joy. Raichu ex and Pikachu ★ light up the whole field.

Energy Connect.description: Ampharos links every light in the valley. Raikou ★ runs across the storm.

Reactive Recharge.description: Magneton keeps the circuits buzzing. Electrode ex is a ticking bomb.

Energy Flame.description: Charizard ex feeds on fire and grows stronger. Moltres ex burns across the sky.

Eruption.description: Camerupt ex's humps rumble with magma. Blaziken leaps out of the smoke.

Bursting Up.description: Typhlosion ex bursts from the flames. Arcanine ex and Entei ★ gallop beside it.

Fox Fire.description: Ninetales lights ghostly flames in the night forest. Houndoom answers with a howl.

Hard Plant.description: Venusaur's roots crack stone and lift whole forests. The jungle grows where it walks.

Johto Garden.description: Meganium's flowers heal the tired land. Celebi wanders by from the future.

Miracle Powder.description: Jumpluff drifts on the wind, scattering sleepy powder. Venomoth flutters behind.

Stadium Power.description: Shiftry rules the old forest stadium. Its leaf fans whip up storms under the Power Tree.

Dust Storm.description: Dustox ex blows a silver wind across the meadow. Beautifly sparkles in the light.

Triple Poison.description: Crobat ex dives through a cloud of toxins. Weezing and Muk make sure it never clears.

Green Essence.description: Sceptile draws strength from the oldest trees. Breloom springs from the forest floor.

Full Bloom.description: Vileplume ex opens its giant flower. Pollen fills the air and items stop working.

Swords Dance.description: Ninjask moves so fast it leaves a ghost behind. Shedinja watches from the shell.

Family Bonds.description: Nidoking and Nidoqueen guard their family with horns and poison. Cacturne ex lurks in the sand.

Root and Claw.description: Anorith and Lileep wake from fossils millions of years old. Armaldo ex leads the ancient tide.

Fossil Excavation.description: Mysterious and Holon fossils wake from the dig. Kabutops and Omastar rule the old seas.

Splash Back.description: Kingler and Crawdaunt ex pinch from the reef. Dark Golduck stares from the depths.

Reactive Lift.description: Wailord rises from the deep like an island. Pelipper and Luvdisc ride on its back.

Suction Cups.description: Kingdra rises from the ocean floor. Octillery's tentacles grab anything that moves.

Swing Dance.description: Ludicolo swings and the rain falls. Milotic ex glides through the puddles like a rainbow.

Icy Aura.description: Walrein ex brings a blizzard. The three Regice guard the frozen cave.

Aurora Beam.description: The Kanto coast glimmers with aurora light. Suicune ★ runs across the icy waves.

Energy Rain.description: Blastoise ex aims its cannons at the sky and the rain never stops.

Twister.description: Gyarados ex rises from the storm. Sharpedo ex and Huntail strike from below.

Mark of Antiquity.description: Kyogre ex wakes in the depths. The ancient markings on its body glow with power.

Water Cyclone.description: Swampert spins a whirlpool through the marsh. Mudkip ★ splashes back for more.

Intimidating Fang.description: Feraligatr's jaws snap the river shut. Croconaw grins from the reeds.

Bright Flame.description: Salamence ex flies at last. Rayquaza ★ shines in the clouds above.

Shining Star.description: Latios ★ glows like a falling star. Rayquaza and Altaria fly at its side.

Lazy Aura.description: Slaking is so lazy that its rivals forget their own powers. Then it hits for 100.

Emerge Charge.description: Flygon ex bursts from the sand with a roar. The desert squad follows its lead.

Quick Search.description: Pidgeot spots its target from the clouds. Dodrio and Swellow race to strike first.

Blissful Support.description: Blissey ex cares for every Pokémon on the bench. Latias ★ shines a healing light.

Metronome.description: Clefable ex wiggles its finger and anything can happen. The fairies of Mt. Moon cheer.

Thick Skin.description: The city's toughest critters live in the back alleys. Persian rules the rooftops.

Mega Throw.description: Exploud's voice shakes the walls. Its band of odd Pokémon backs every note.

Brick Smash.description: Machamp breaks bricks with a single chop. Hariyama ex stomps into the ring.

Hitmon Dojo.description: Hitmonchan, Hitmonlee and Hitmontop train under the same master. Medicham ex keeps the peace.

Rock Hurl.description: Golem's avalanche crashes down the slope. Groudon ★ cuts the earth in two.

Healing Stone.description: Regirock ex heals with stones older than humanity. Donphan and Groudon shake the ground.

Steel Wing.description: Registeel's iron body never rusts. Scizor ex and Steelix ex guard the steel kingdom.

Super Connectivity.description: Metagross links four minds into one. Metagross ★ shines like a fallen star.

Losing Control.description: Tyranitar ex rampages through the mountains. Dark Tyranitar walks in its footprints.

Driving Howl.description: Mightyena ex's howl drives rivals away. Absol and Sableye wait in the shadows.

Rocket's Smog.description: A green fog seeps from Team Rocket's lab. Dark Crobat and Dark Weezing feed on it.

Rocket's Generator.description: Team Rocket powers its base with stolen lightning. Rocket's Raikou ex runs the dynamo.

Rocket's Undertow.description: Team Rocket's submarine prowls the depths. Rocket's Suicune ex guards the hatch.

Rocket's Inferno.description: Team Rocket's forge glows red. Rocket's Entei ex and Moltres ex keep the fires burning.

Rocket's Bunker.description: Team Rocket dug a bunker under the mountain. Dark Steelix guards the tunnels.

Rocket's Dark Trance.description: Dark Dragonite rises from Team Rocket's darkest lab. Dark Hypno keeps it in a trance.

Rocket's Night Cry.description: When Rocket's Persian ex cries in the night, the boss's finest stolen Pokémon are ready.

Delta Dragons.description: Strange storms crackle over the Holon region. Dragonite δ and Salamence δ ride the lightning.

Holon Flame.description: In Holon, even sea dragons breathe fire. Tyranitar δ and Kingdra δ burn through the waves.

Delta Storm.description: Holon's magnetic sky changed everything it touched. Metagross δ and Gyarados δ crackle with power.

Delta Prism.description: Holon's Eevee evolve in colors nobody has seen before. Each one hides a new secret.

Holon Bloom.description: Holon's flowers grow in the sea and its stars swim. Bellossom δ dances under the waves.

Holon Circuit.description: Holon's scientists wired Pokémon into living batteries. Raichu δ runs the whole circuit.

Delta Swarm.description: In Holon, bugs and bats shine with metal. Flygon δ leads the swarm across the dunes.

Delta Pack.description: Holon's wild hunters have strange new colors. Mightyena δ leads the pack through the night.

Dark Palm.description: A cold hand reaches out of the dark and drags its prey away. Dusknoir rules the restless spirits.

Imprison.description: Gardevoir heals with her dance. Gardevoir ex from Holon locks every power in her cage.

Type Shift.description: Claydol ex changes the color of the world around it. Lunatone and Solrock spin overhead.

Unown Puzzle.description: The ruins hold a riddle written in Unown. Alakazam ★ is the only one who can read it.

Forme Shift.description: A visitor from space shifts its shape to win every fight. Deoxys never shows the same face twice.

Ominous Wind.description: Drifblim drifts away with lost children's balloons. Drapion hides under the sand.

Mythical Mew.description: Mew plays among the clouds and Celebi travels through time. Mewtwo ★ remembers them both.

Evolution Rays.description: Espeon ★ shines a purple ray and Eevee evolves. Ho-Oh ex brings all the colors.

Volt Tackle.description: Electivire roars and the power lines go dark. Pikachu ★ sparkles in the thunder.

Gleam Eyes.description: Luxray sees through walls with its golden eyes. Pachirisu runs errands across the storm.

Static Flock.description: Ampharos lights the hills and Manectric ex charges the clouds. Jolteon ★ finishes the storm.

Magnetize.description: Magnezone floats in from Sinnoh, pulling every magnet in the land. Electrode is ready to blow.

Fire Fang.description: Charizard returns with a fiery roar. Charizard ★ swirls the dark flames of the frontier.

Burn Away.description: Blaziken ex burns everything away. Camerupt ex and Arbok smolder in the ashes.

Flame Swirl.description: Arcanine ex gallops through a swirl of fire. Entei ★ shakes the volcano awake.

Flare Up.description: Infernape's head burns with fighting spirit. Ninetales and Flareon ★ fan the flames.

Forest Murmurs.description: Torterra carries a whole forest on its back. Celebi ★ watches over the trees.

Solar Garden.description: Venusaur and Meganium ex bathe in the sun. Sunflora dances in the garden.

Attack Order.description: Vespiquen commands her hive with a single buzz. Roserade guards the flower beds.

Dark Eyes.description: Shiftry ex's dark eyes punish any trick. The forest whispers when it walks by.

Silk Road.description: Dustox ex and Beautifly glide over the silk road. Masquerain flashes its scary eyes.

Poison Ring.description: Crobat ex circles above the poison ring. Below, Weezing and Muk bubble and hiss.

Leaf Blade.description: Sceptile's leaves are sharper than any sword. Breloom and Scyther fight at its side.

Stun Spore Garden.description: Vileplume shakes its petals and the garden goes still. Victreebel waits with open jaws.

Loose Shell.description: Ninjask sheds its shell in a blur. What it leaves behind is Shedinja.

Dark Horn.description: From Holon's dark hills come Nidoking δ and Nidoqueen δ. Their horns shine like black steel.

Fossil Charge.description: Armaldo and Cradily march out of the past. The ancient reef comes back to life.

Ancient Shell.description: Shells and claws stir in the ancient dig. Aerodactyl screeches from the cave.

Brine.description: Empoleon rules the frozen sea with its steel blades. Floatzel races through the waves.

Pincer Pond.description: The pond belongs to the crabs. Latios ex and Palkia keep watch from above.

Whale Watch.description: Wailord rises like an island at sea. Mew ★ splashes alongside the giant.

Protective Swirl.description: Kingdra ex from Holon hides in its own smoke. Octillery grips the reef.

Rain Splash.description: Ludicolo dances and the rain falls. Milotic ex reflects every color of the storm.

Glacia's Blizzard.description: The Elite Four's ice queen calls a blizzard. Walrein ex and the Regice trio obey.

Frozen Kiss.description: Jynx blows a frozen kiss across the bay. Suicune ★ runs over the frozen waves.

Ultra Pump.description: Swampert ex pumps a flood through the marsh. Quagsire smiles at nothing in particular.

Smash Turn.description: Blastoise smashes in and spins out. Politoed ex leads the frogs of the falls.

Hydro Fangs.description: Gyarados bares its fangs above the waves. Vaporeon ★ melts into the water.

Primal Tide.description: Kyogre ex and Palkia meet where space and sea collide. The tide will never be the same.

Tsunami Fang.description: Feraligatr's tsunami crashes onto the shore. Sudowoodo pretends to be a tree.

Salamence Sky.description: Salamence ex rules the sky and Rayquaza ★ shines above. Blissey ex tends the wounded.

Eon Duet.description: Latias ex and Latios ex fly in from Holon. Latios ★ leads them home.

Slack Attack.description: Slaking finally gets up and the whole field shakes. Lopunny bounces along beside it.

Sand Pit.description: Flygon ex hides in the sand pit of the desert. Latias ★ heals those lost in the dunes.

Brave Bird.description: Staraptor dives with a brave heart. Dodrio and Pidgeot race across the sky.

Moon Kick.description: The fairies of Mt. Moon dance under the stars. Clefable and Delcatty ex lead the waltz.

High Hat.description: Purugly rules the back alleys with a stern look. The city crew follows its every whim.

Scavenge.description: Bibarel collects everything that washes downstream. Its odd friends join the treasure hunt.

Aura Sphere.description: Lucario reads the aura of every rival. The Hitmon masters spar in its dojo.

Dynamic Punch.description: Machamp's four arms swing like a storm. Hariyama ex stands firm in the ring.

Earth Fissure.description: Rhyperior cracks the earth with its drill. Groudon ★ rises from the fissure.

Ground Slash.description: Donphan rolls across the plains and the ground shakes. Regirock ex guards the ancient stones.

Metal Gravity.description: Skarmory ex and Aggron ex hold the iron mountain. Dialga watches the flow of time.

Steel Slash.description: Steelix coils through the mountain's iron veins. Scizor ex cuts with steel wings.

Meteor Fist.description: Metagross punches like a falling star. Jirachi ex grants a wish every thousand years.

Shatter.description: Tyranitar ex rampages and mountains shatter. Even Holon's Tyranitar δ joins the fury.

Cursed Eyes.description: Absol ex appears before the storm. Weavile and Skuntank prowl under Umbreon ★'s dark ray.

Delta Charge.description: Strange storms crackle over the Holon region. Dragonite δ and Salamence δ ride the lightning.

Dragon Roar.description: In Holon's jungles, Dragonite ex δ roars among the trees. Even Snorlax δ grows leaves.

Holon Inferno.description: Holon's seas boil with dragon fire. Tyranitar δ and Kingdra δ rise from the flames.

Delta Thunder.description: Holon's magnetic storms charge every feather and fin. Metagross δ commands the thunder.

Peal of Thunder.description: Charizard δ crackles with lightning over Holon. Feraligatr δ thunders from the river.

Holon Eevees.description: Holon's Eevee shine with metal and strange colors. Each evolution is a new mystery.

Delta Bouquet.description: In Holon, flowers bloom underwater. Bellossom δ and Starmie δ dance with the tide.

Holon Dynamo.description: Holon's scientists wired Pokémon into living batteries. Raichu δ runs the whole circuit.

Psychic Mirage.description: Holon's desert hides psychic flames. Flygon ex δ and Ninetales δ shimmer like a mirage.

Delta Hunters.description: Holon's wild hunters have strange new colors. Mightyena δ leads the pack through the night.

Dragon Frontiers.description: At Holon's frontier, even gentle Gardevoir δ burns with fire. Meganium δ blooms in flames.
